name: ThinkQuantum
description: ThinkQuantum develops QKD systems for fiber, free-space, and satellite quantum communication links using polarization-encoded single photons and the BB84 protocol. The company's QUKY platform addresses secure communication across multiple channel types. ThinkQuantum was spun out of the University of Padova and received EIC Transition funding.
funding: EIC Transition grant (~€2.5M); partner in QSNP EU project
